Game Overview

In Falling Baldman, the core idea is straightforward: guide the bald man to safety in this thrilling descent. Master your landing skills, dodge deadly obstacles, and collect bananas to boost your score. Tension mounts as you avoid spikes from above. How far can you guide him unharmed?

Playing Falling Baldman comes down to a simple loop. Guide the bald man to safety in this thrilling descent! Master your landing skills, dodge deadly obstacles, and collect bananas to boost your score. Tension mounts as you avoid spikes from above. How far can you guide him unharmed?
